programme.title: Top Secret! Die geheimsten Orte der Welt
programme.desc: Die National Security Agency ist der mächtigste – und am wenigsten verstandene – Geheimdienst der Welt. Das Geschehen in ihrem Hauptquartier ist eines der bestgehüteten Geheimnisse der Neuzeit.\n\nDoch Fort Meade ist nur die sichtbare Spitze eines globalen Geheimdienstnetzwerks. Diese Folge enthüllt ein weltweites System aus Abhörstationen und Datenknotenpunkten, das ein Überwachungsnetz bildet, das Kontinente und Ozeane überspannt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Secret! Die geheimsten Orte der Welt
programme.desc:
Nur wenige wissenschaftliche Einrichtungen haben so viel Aufmerksamkeit – oder kritische Beobachtung – auf sich gezogen wie das Institut für Virologie Wuhan.

Das Institut beherbergt Chinas einziges Labor der Biosicherheitsstufe 4 (BSL-4) und wurde errichtet, um die gefährlichsten Krankheitserreger der Welt unter strengsten Sicherheitsvorkehrungen zu erforschen.

Was jedoch in seinen Labors vor sich geht, bleibt der Außenwelt weitgehend verborgen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Planet der Tiere
programme.desc:
Vor Millionen von Jahren war der größte Teil Australiens mit Regenwald bedeckt – ein Land, in dem Dinosaurier umherstreiften und Seeungeheuer in Binnenmeeren kreuzten.

Der Asteroideneinschlag, der die Dinosaurier auslöschte, war der Ausgangspunkt für dramatische Veränderungen.

Säugetiere eroberten die Erde, als sie sich allmählich abkühlte und austrocknete – und Australien erlebte die Entstehung einer einzigartigen und außergewöhnlichen Tierwelt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Planet der Tiere
programme.desc:
Das Beringmeer liegt zwischen Alaska und Russland und verbirgt die Überreste einer verlorenen Welt.

Während der letzten Kaltzeit, als die Ozeane um mehr als 100 Meter zurückgingen, wurde die Landbrücke, die als Beringia bekannt ist, freigelegt. Sie war eisfrei und bot Tieren aus dem Osten und dem Westen einen Zufluchtsort.

Diese Landbrücke ermöglichte die Vermischung von Tieren, die wir heute als asiatisch, europäisch und amerikanisch bezeichnen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Agatha Christies Poirot
programme.desc: An Bord eines Flugzeugs, das vom Flughafen Le Bourget bei Paris nach Croydon Airport in London fliegt, geschieht ein Mord. Poirot, einer der Passagiere, steht vor einem Rätsel und versucht, den mysteriösen Mord aufzuklären.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: Eine Explosion, in die eine geheimnisvolle Frau verwickelt ist, der Watts nachgeht, führt Murdoch zu einer geheimen Gemeinschaft.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Agatha Christies Poirot
programme.desc: Poirot verbringt Weihnachten bei dem Ägyptologen Lacey, allerdings in dienstlichem Auftrag. Denn unter den Feiernden wird der Drahtzieher eines Diebstahls vermutet: Dem ägyptischen Thronfolger ist ein wertvoller Rubin gestohlen worden.

programme.title: Agatha Christies Poirot
programme.desc: Poirot wird von Lady Chatterton gebeten, ein Auge auf ihre Freundin Marguerite Clayton zu haben, die sich von ihrem Mann bedroht fühlt. Kurz darauf wird dessen Leiche in einer spanischen Truhe in der Wohnung von Major Rich entdeckt.

programme.title: Agatha Christies Poirot
programme.desc: Poirot wird vom Wirt eines Landgasthofs per Brief gebeten, einen dreifachen Giftmord aufzuklären. Bei seiner Ankunft muss er jedoch erfahren, dass das Verbrechen nur auf dem Papier existiert: im selbstverfassten Kriminalroman des Wirts.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Während einer Hamlet-Probe wird ein Theaterregisseur tot aufgefunden, auch Drama hinter der Bühne.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: Die Entdeckung der Leiche eines jungen Mädchens, sowie einiger grotesker Zeichnungen, führt Murdoch zu dem Verdacht, dass eine Gruppe von Jugendlichen, die vom Tod besessen sind, dahintersteckt. Unter ihnen ist auch ein gewisser H. P. Lovecraft.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Der Verdacht des Mr. Whicher
programme.desc: Im Auftrag von Sir Henry Coverly beschattet Mr. Whicher dessen Frau wegen des Verdachts der ehelichen Untreue. Er findet heraus, dass Lady Jane Coverly ein Verhältnis mit Matthew Thorogood hat. Nachdem er Sir Henry Bericht erstattet hat und es zu einem Scheidungstermin vor Gericht kommt, erscheint Matthew Thorogood trotz Vorladung nicht. Als Mr. Whicher der Sache nachgeht, findet er Matthew kurz darauf ermordet im Wald.

programme.title: SWR3 Comedy Festival
programme.desc: In Bad Dürkheim treten der "Marokkaner Deines Vertrauens" Abdelkarim, die jungen Comedians Ivan Thieme und Sara Karas sowie der Meister deutsch-russischer Comedy Nikita Miller zu einem unterhaltsamen Comedy-Festival auf.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Charlotte bemüht sich Friedrich gegenüber um Normalität, auch wenn ihr das nur schwer gelingt: Barbaras Behauptung hat sie sehr verunsichert. Als Charlotte einen schlimmen Albtraum hat, in dem Friedrich sie umbringt, begreift sie, dass sie ihn endlich mit Barbaras Verdacht konfrontieren muss. Charlotte stellt Friedrich schließlich erneut die Frage, ob er Patrizia wirklich nicht die Treppe herunter gestoßen habe. Friedrich leugnet zunächst, doch Charlotte setzt ihn weiter unter Druck.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Leonard sucht Paulines Nähe und bietet ihr an, ein Praktikum bei ihm in der Geschäftsführung zu machen, um sich in die Hotelleitung einzuarbeiten. Pauline zögert, doch sie sehnt sich nach Leonards Nähe. Leonard gesteht derweil Martin, dass auch er auf eine Versöhnung hofft. Als Friedrich Pauline in Anwesenheit eines Notars schließlich die 20 Prozent seiner Anteile überschreibt, erleidet er einen Schwächeanfall. Charlotte erwartet von Friedrich, dass er sich selbst anzeigt.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Barbara missfällt die neuerliche Annäherung zwischen Pauline und Leonard. Sie erinnert Leonard an seine Pflicht als werdender Vater, doch Leonard weist die Verantwortung für die Zwillinge zunächst harsch zurück - bis in ihm ungeahnte Vatergefühle erwachen, als er den Herzschlag seiner vermeintlichen Kinder hört. Pauline indes hadert mit sich, ob der Preis für ihr Glück mit Leonard nicht zu hoch ist, und trifft eine folgenschwere Entscheidung.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Leonard beteuert zwar, dass sich seine Gefühle geändert haben, als er im Krankenhaus die Herztöne seiner vermeintlichen Kinder gehört hat, doch Pauline glaubt ihm nicht. Auch behagt es ihr nicht, dass sie nun als Anteilseignerin noch viel mehr an den "Fürstenhof" und damit auch an Leonard gebunden ist. Als Charlotte Leonard erklärt, dass die Liebe allein manchmal nicht reicht, wenn die Basis einer Beziehung zerstört ist, schreibt er Pauline einen Brief, deren Zeilen sie mitten ins Herz treffen.

programme.title: Hauptstadtrevier
programme.desc: Ein Schuppen in der Schrebergartenkolonie ist Brandstiftern zum Opfer gefallen. Die Laubenpieper werden seit Monaten regelrecht terrorisiert. programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E06 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con Esdras Rangel, exarquero de Pumas y miembro de la Selección Juvenil Mexicana, para revivir los momentos clave de su vida y carrera deportiva. Desde sus inicios como delantero a los cuatro años, hasta convertirse en portero profesional, Rangel comparte anécdotas, aprendizajes y desafíos de su trayectoria en el futbol mexicano. Fiel a sus raíces auriazules, Esdras repasa su debut, su admiración por Jorge Campos y su papel en el campeonato de Pumas en 2004, que considera el momento cumbre de su carrera. También habla sobre su experiencia en Jaguares de Chiapas, su retiro a los 30 años, y el respaldo incondicional de su familia en cada etapa. A lo largo de la conversación, el exjugador reflexiona sobre lo que implica defender el arco, la presión de la posición, la competencia interna y la transición hacia la vida fuera del campo.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Adriana “Ady” Jiménez, clavadista mexicana y campeona mundial de clavados de altura, quien nos comparte cómo el deporte marcó cada etapa de su vida. Desde sus inicios en el karate hasta su ingreso al Comité Olímpico Mexicano a los 13 años, Ady Jiménez recuerda la disciplina, los sacrificios y los sueños que la formaron como atleta. Entre anécdotas de infancia, frustraciones como perder un pase olímpico en 2004 y el retiro temporal que la alejó de la plataforma durante una década, la clavadista narra su sorprendente regreso: decretar antes de saltar, vencer el miedo y abrazar la adrenalina de los 20 metros de altura. Hoy, retirada oficialmente desde 2022, Ady busca dejar un legado a través de la nueva federación de clavados, convencida de que el miedo no es un obstáculo, sino un motor. Su historia es un viaje de resiliencia, pasión y amor absoluto por el deporte.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Evil Island Of Dr. B
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Gerry of Team Psychic's lack of control led to an explosive conclusion when his Cyber Bit Beast blew up. The Blade Breakers were at a loss as to how that could happen so Kenny consulted his trusty laptop Dizzi and made a startling revelation. Someone had managed to make copies of the Blade Breakers Bit Beasts! This discovery leads the gang to believe that new powerful Bit Beasts are being developed and they decide to get themselves in shape for battle. Ozuma and his gang, the Saint Shields, are still eager to test the power of the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts as well, so they head to the beach where Tyson and the others are training. Meanwhile Doctor B is busy experimenting with various versions of a Cyber Bit Beast with mixed results.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai's classmate Wyatt returns and begs Kai to help him train to become a first-class Beyblader. Remembering the time back at school that Wyatt betrayed Kai by stealing Dranzer and using it in battle, Kai turns him down. Hurt, Wyatt vows to return and battle Kai one day. That day may be sooner than anyone thinks' for the mysterious Dr. B and his team of scientists have finally re-developed the Cyber Bit Beast and are looking for a Blader with the skill to handle it. Dr. B approaches Wyatt with an offer to join Team Psykick, and Wyatt jumps at the chance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Dunga and Wyatt battle, Wyatt realizes he doesn't possess the skill necessary to control his Cyber Bit Beast. This frustrates Gideon, so he commands Doctor B to seek out a suitable candidate for the job. Meanwhile, Tyson is back home practicing his blading and quickly tires of it. The rest of the BladeBreakers, including Hilary, keep harping on him to continue until he gets it right. But Tyson has had enough and quits! It seems the BladeBreakers are finished! Then, Hilary comes up with an idea! She tells the guys to take a day off and invites them to an afternoon barbecue with Grandpa playing the part of the Chef. At first Tyson wants nothing to do with it, but finally he relents and joins in. After lunch, the kids relax by the river while Grandpa fishes. Suddenly he hooks a big one and gets dragged in the water! The kids run to the rescue, however, a group of four new teenagers appear out of nowhere and rescue Gramps. After a brief conversation, our heroes realize these new kids are also Bladers, so Tyson challenges their leader, Kane, to a battle. After a fierce fight, it ends in a tie and the new kids leave. Tyson thinks he made a new friend, but as it turns out, Kane is the leader of the Psykick's and is in cahoots with the evil Gideon!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, and Salima arrive at Doctor B's lab to begin battle tests for Gideon. Jim goes first after being given his new Beyblade, Cyber Draciel. He battles against a lopsided number of automated Beyblades, including one behemoth the size of a football. But with Cyber Draciel in tow, victory is decisive. It's obvious however, that the Cyber Bit-Beast's power is having a corrupting influence on Jim. At Mr. Dickenson's office, the BladeBreakers are blackmailed into a future battle against the Psykick's when Doctor B threatens an all-out assault on the city by the Cyber Bit-Beasts. When Tyson hears that his new friend Kane has joined the Psykick's, he refuses to believe it without concrete proof.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After seeing the power of the Cyber Bit Beasts in Team Psykick's Beyblades, Tyson vows to do whatever it takes to beat them. Even if that means breaking the rules and modifying his own Beyblade. Ray protests and demands that the BladeBreakers play fair even if the odds are against them. In a quiet moment down by the river he runs into Salima of Team Psykick and discovers she feels the same way as he does. Salima tries to convince Ray to get the BladeBreakers to forfeit their upcoming match and even offers to reveal the secrets of the Cyber Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is so determined to beat the Psykick's in an upcoming battle that he's ordered Kenny to modify his Dragoon beyond legal specifications. But because his blade now has too much offensive power, Tyson is unable to control it and he becomes totally frustrated with himself and his blade. The more he tries controlling it, the worse he becomes. His friends try to tell him 'cheating' isn't the way to win, yet Tyson ignores them and being pigheaded as he is, he goes off to sulk about his dilemma.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers travel by helicopter to their re-match against the Psykick's. During the flight, Hilary remembers how Psykick trapped her and Kenny on a cargo ship; Max ponders their recent training; Kai regrets the Psykick' mistreatment of Wyatt;; Ray recalls the time Salima reached out to him; and Tyson remains bitter about Kane joining Psykick. When they arrive at the battle location - a five-story, monolithic building called 'The Battle Tower' - they're greeted by Gideon via video screen, who outlines the format. On each floor, one Psykick awaits a different Blade Breaker, and each match will be a one-match-only sudden death battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Max Takes One For The Team
programme.desc: The first battle between Team Psykick and the Bladebreakers has begun! Max fights bravely against Jim and Cyber Draciel' and his teammates aren't the only ones interested in the outcome of the battle. Dr. B and Gideon watch from the sidelines, and the Saint Sheilds are there to watch their backs. Max defeats Jim, but amazingly, Cyber Draciel is repaired!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Bigger The Cyber-Driger, The Harder It Falls
programme.desc: A confused and heartbroken Ray must face Salima in a dangerous challenge of Drigers! Despite the threat of losing his bit-beast forever, Ray hesitates' baffled by the extreme change in Salima's personality. It wasn't long ago that she confided in Ray and told him of the troubling bit-beast experiments being conducted by the Psykick's' and now' it looks like she's in the same boat as Goki and Jim! Mind-Controlled by their own cyber-bit-beasts! But Ray can't stand back for long' not after realizing his team is depending on him' and even in the face of team Psykick's blatant cheating' Ray refuses to back down' he's not just fighting for a win' he's fighting to bring back the Salima he once knew!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Thanks to Ray's spectacular victory over Salima, the Bladebreakers reach the fourth level of Gideon's Battle Tower and meet their next opponent, Goki of the Psykick's. As Kai steps forward to meet the challenge Gideon and Doctor B prepare several surprises for the team. Using the information gathered from the previous two Beybattles, Doctor B has programmed Driger and Draciel's attack patterns into Goki's Beyblade. Meanwhile, the Saint Shields continue to explore the Psykick's headquarters in an attempt to find Max's captured Draciel.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Ozuma and his gang have barged into the laboratory complex to help Tyson, however, because the building is so massive, they can't find the right room! They frantically split up and race to find their friends. Back in the battle, Tyson's words have hit a chord with Kane and he decides not to call out the Cyber Dragoon to fight for him. Instead, he wants to win it on his own. Gideon and Doctor B are incensed, but because Kane wants to win so badly, he accidentally triggers the Cyber Bit Beast to launch and now the battle has taken a turn for the worse as it grows in power' at least for Tyson!!".

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson faces off against Kane of Team Psykick and soon realizes his opponent has an unnatural advantage. Thanks to Doctor B, Kane has a powerful Cyber Bit Beast inside of his Blade. This means that when Tyson summons Dragoon, Kane's Cyber Bit Beast has the ability to copy Dragoon's moves and even improve on them. It's obvious from the get go that Kane's Cyber Bit Beast's powers are developing at an alarming rate and when it starts controlling his mind that's when things really get out of hand. Although a good Blader in his own right, under the control of the Cyber Bit Beast Kane's personality begins to change and when he's confronted by Salima he snaps and totally succumbs to its power.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Cyber Dragoon is blown to oblivion, so is the building they are in and it starts collapsing all around them. Our heroes make a mad dash for the exits when, Max realizes his Draciel is still being held captive in the lab. Max races back inside followed closely by Tyson. Once inside the lab, they meet up with Ozuma and his gang who free Draciel for Max using their blades. Now it's a race to try and get out of the building safely!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After the kids arrive in NYC, Max's mother, Judy, takes them to the BBA research lab where she shows them an ancient rock, covered in mysterious writing. Judy reveals that not only is the rock believed to hold the secret of the Bit Beasts, but an organized crime syndicate is plotting to steal it. A test battle is fought, using a bit containing a piece of the rock but the power it produces is far too unstable. The Blader who performed the test turns out to be Max's school friend, Alan, and the two pals make plans to enter a Beyblade tournament scheduled for the next day. But that night, the rock is stolen. Tyson grabs a bike and sets off in hot pursuit, using a practice blade to blow out the getaway car's tire. The thieves take off on foot and Max runs into them only to discover that his pal, Alan, is in on the plot.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Bad Seed In The Big Apple
programme.desc: Alan tells Max that if Max wins, he'll explain why he agreed to steal the rock with a bunch of shady thieves. The battle is heated and Max is determined to win. After one draw and several close calls, Max finally wins. In the end Alan explains that he was approached by some underworld characters who convinced him if he stole the rock they would give him a new, more powerful Beyblade . But the new blade turns out to be a dud and Alan is left to explain why he did what he did to Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Get A Piece Of The Rock
programme.desc: When the kids return to Japan accompanied by Judy, they are taken to an abandoned research facility where Mr. Dickenson had once worked on a similar rock with his old partner, Dr. Zagart. Like the one that was stolen from the BBA, this rock was covered in mysterious writing and possessed strange powers. Unfortunately, it too disappeared, along with Dr. Zagart who was never seen again. After a battle with Kenny and his new 'Einstein' Beyblade, Tyson realizes he still has to learn how to control his new, ultra-powerful Beyblade, Dragoon V2. While practicing down by the river, he is challenged to a battle by Ozuma and the Saint Shields. Tyson accepts and manages to hold his own until the entire Saint Shields clan gangs up on him. It looks like all is lost until a mysterious stranger steps in to save the battle and the day. But the Saint Shields vow to return and fulfill their mission to capture and seal the four Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Attack Of The Rock Bit Beast
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson and Max's Mom show up at Tyson's dojo empty-handed. Dr. Zagart and the mysterious rock have vanished without a trace. Knowing Dr. Zagart is the key to finding the missing rock, the BladeBreakers decide to launch their own search. One problem, they have no idea where to start looking. Meanwhile Dr. Zagart and Dr. K have designed a new powerful Blade using the rock, and they've chosen a Blader named Foxy to challenge our heroes. While Tyson is busy with Zeo, the boy he met the day before when he fought Ozuma, Foxy attacks. Never one to turn down a challenge Ray follows Foxy into the woods. Foxy's rock powered Blade nearly destroys Ray's Blade but Tyson shows up in the nick of time and coaches Ray to victory. The BladeBreakers congratulate Ray on his victory but the Saint Shields also witnessed the battle. Intrigued, Ozuma vows more than ever to get the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In the quiet after Foxy's storm, the BladeBreakers try to figure out who or what was behind his attack, and how it all tied into the mysterious Rock. Meanwhile, Tyson reaches a breaking point, discouraged and upset by the constant attempts of fanatic groups trying to steal the sacred bit-beasts. His anxiety goes overboard when he coaxes Kenny to create a wacky training platform for the team to practice with. He takes his jaded attitude out on Zeo, who simply wants to spar with one of the greats. At the same time, The Saint Shields' frustration level also grows, as Ozuma decides that the Bladebreakers are unworthy of possessing the sacred bit-beasts any longer. Tyson remembers the simple joys of Beyblading when he finally agrees to train with Zeo and coaches him so he can pass his Beyblading exam. The proud feeling that Tyson gets may just be enough to get him and his team through these tough times'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson deciphers the words that are carved onto the mysterious rocks and reads the kids this warning; 'Dare not disturb this stone, for here, the Bit Beasts are sealed.' The kids realize that the Saint Shields are part of a clan which still uses this ancient language and they resolve to confront them, even if it means battling and losing their Beyblades in the bargain. Ozuma reveals the history of the Bit Beasts to the Bladebreakers, telling of them of their origin as benevolent spirits until evil men discovered how to control them and use them for their own malicious needs. Since that time, the clan of the Saint Shields has made it their mission to seal the Bit Beasts and save the world from destruction. Dunga issues a battle challenge to the Bladebreakers and Ray answers it with confidence, but Dunga's new Vortex Ape proves too much for Driger. After Ray's Bit Beast is taken, the team goes into training but will they be able to save Driger without putting themselves into further jeopardy?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Doctor K has extracted a Spider Bit Beast from the rock and gives it to a new Blader named Net whose mission is to go out and capture Tyson's Dragoon. As Tyson races to a Junior Beyblade Tournament, Net cuts him off and draws him into battle. During the fight, Net keeps telling Tyson to release his Dragoon so he can steal it, but when Tyson finally does, Dragoon wins and Net runs away crying. In the end, Zeo absorbs the lesson taught to him by the BladeBreakers who invite him to train with them.".

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: See No Bit Beast, Hear No Bit Beast
programme.desc: Kai is busy practicing his Beyblade skills alone in the park when out of nowhere a gust of wind appears and starts slicing everything to pieces. It turns out that it's the work of Jack, one of Dr. K's Blader's, and he's got a Bit Beast that harnesses the wind. Once the BladeBreakers figure this out, Ray volunteers to fight, but Kai stops him and sneaks out in the middle of the night to battle Jack. Discovering Kai is gone, the gang runs and finds him just as he's about to begin the battle. The gang realizes Kai doesn't stand a chance against this wind Bit Beast because he can't see it. Reluctantly they let Kai fight. An intense battle ensues and Kai takes a severe beating as he waits to catch a glimpse of Jack's Bit Beast. Finally Kai summons Dranzer and spots the wind Bit Beast and defeats it. Defeated, Jack runs off while Kai leaves the rest of BladeBreakers in awe as he walks off into the night.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Goaded by Dunga, Mariam goes off to capture Max's Draciel and finds him battling Dennis and his Bit Beast, Tyranno. Using his new Bit Finder Kenny measures Tyranno's impressive strength and is surprised when Dennis backs out of the battle before using its full power. Unaware that Mariam is following him, Max runs off in pursuit of Dennis and finds himself deep in the bowels of a mysterious building. He is ambushed by Dennis- who is now backed up by Dr. K and her Technicians. Mariam lies in wait, planning on taking Draciel once Tyranno weakens him. But when she discovers that Dr. K is using Power Injection to make Tyranno even stronger, Mariam launches Sharkrash and destroys the machinery and much of the building with it. It is now up to Max and Mariam to work together to find a way out of the crumbling building. But will Mariam capture Draciel once they escape?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fed up with all the recent attempts by Zagart and others to acquire the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts for sinister purposes, The Saint Shields decide to take action. Having already acquired Ray's Bit-Beast Driger in an earlier match, the Saint Shields confront our heroes again. They challenge the BladeBreakers to a match at an abandoned amusement park. The BladeBreakers know that if they lose, The Saint Shields will seal their Bit Beasts away forever in a mysterious rock to prevent them from being used for evil.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Fate Of The Spark Battle
programme.desc: But just when things start to heat up, Ray launches his blade to try to even the score. As the battle rages, the roller coaster collapses around all the blades and it appears our heroes are done for, especially since Ray is fighting without his Driger! But Ray is determined not to lose again and using his amazing powers of concentration, he's able to release his Bit Beast from the rock and with it, Ray and Kai defeat their opponents. The battle ends in victory just as Ozuma, who is furious, steps up and warns Tyson his Dragoon will be the next to be sealed!!

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level
programme.desc: One day, a girl with rabbit ears comes to the village of Flatta. This nameless, unpopular minstrel, who strums her lute fiercely with her bare fingers and sings with a death growl, is known as Schifanoia. When she passes out in the middle of her concert, Azusa is reminded of the sad stories she's heard of young men who moved to Tokyo hoping to make their major debut, but instead turn into job-hopping middle-aged men playing in bands that never make any profit. So she invites Schifanoia to live at the house in the highlands for a while, but when she just keeps making excuses and refuses to see reality, Flatorte loses her patience...

programme.title: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level
programme.sub-title: I Ate a Mushroom and Turned Into a Child
programme.desc: Halkara throws a mushroom-grilling party, or "shroompa" for short, and accidently includes some poisonous mushrooms that cause anyone who eats them to shrink... and Azusa eats one. This leads to everyone ridiculing her,or rather, fawning over how cute she looks. Even her daughters are in on it! Azusa is determined to change back to normal, so after a tip from Pecora, she heads to the World Tree along with Fatla and Vania to find a pharmacist who deals in every kind of medicine. She expects a dungeon with 108 floors to fight through, but...

programme.title: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level
programme.desc: Festival season has come to the village of Flatta. The festival has been held there for the past 250 years, but as the only person who knows its entire history since it was started, Azusa has distanced herself from it to let the villagers keep their independence. But her family has shown interest in it and seems excited to see it, so she makes up her mind to change the way she interacts with the village tradition... and thus the one-day-only coffee shop, The Witch's House, was born. Will the villagers enjoy this little shop Azusa's family has created?

programme.title: RADIANT
programme.sub-title: The Will of the People Shines Bright -Resistance-
programme.desc: The mysterious knight turned out to be Doc trapped in a suit of armor along with several memory stones. The soldiers race to rescue the queen, but Verone's petrifying ability impedes them. Santori attempts to have some fun in his battle with Seth and ends up causing him to go berserk. Santori then talks about using people as if they were tools, causing him to explode with rage. Ocoho and Melie are also boiling with resentment in their respective battles against Doussant and Liselotte.

programme.title: RADIANT
programme.desc: Cornered by Ocoho, the Merchant Barons show their true colors. It seemed this would be the end of the battle, but the when the Inquisitor Ullmina learns that Santori has been lost, she has an even more powerful Harmonizium dropped into the forest. The Fantasia there begins to disappear, and the soldiers under the control of Ullmina's powerful miracle close in on the castle wall. Seth hurries to the forest, concerned about Myr and Jill, and he finds Myr in a state of despair. His grief over losing what was most precious to him then turns to intense rage...

programme.title: RADIANT
programme.sub-title: A Bouquet of Flowers for This Land -Fantasia-

programme.title: RADIANT

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.desc: Things get a little wild with a very passionate guest named Wanda. Her daughter, Tiffany, told her mother she ruined her wedding, among many other things. programme.desc: Tamara, guía de una galería de arte privada, es acusada de robar las joyas del renombrado coleccionista Dubrovsky. Indignado, él la busca para encararla, pero descubre que ella también es víctima de la estafa, no la villana que imaginaba. Entre ambos nace un romance. Pero el amor no será sencillo: Tamara lleva años enamorada en secreto del dueño de la galería, de cuyo favor depende su suerte, y Dubrovsky está casado con una esposa que no piensa quedarse de brazos cruzados.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto se lleva a Natalia de la fiesta y la golpea obligándola a arrodillarse. Le habla como si fuera Consuelo. Eustoquio confiesa a Isaías su infancia traumática jurando venganza contra todos. Robert y Andreína celebran sentando bases del matrimonio. Junior discute con Rosa porque ella se niega a dormir con él. Rosalía visita a Erasto y le revela los planes de Alejandro sobre las tierras. Eustoquio se niega a entregar los documentos a Blanca, prefiriendo extorsionar a Erasto. Rosa anuncia que irá a hablar con su madre Carmen Rosa para que se mude con ellos.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia va al hospital a ver a Artemio para preguntarle sobre el paradero de su hija. Artemio se encuentra en muy mal estado de salud pero puede decirle algo, le alcanza a decir que había sido él quien le había quitado a su hija en la creencia de que Clemencia había muerto y la había llevado con Olga Valdez pero luego trata de hablar y no puede más y muere. Clemencia se queda angustiada porque Olga Valdez está en cama y no puede hablar ni moverse.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.sub-title: Episodio 22: La boda de Ana y Cristobal
programme.desc: Ana sigue en duda de casarse con Cristóbal o salir corriendo a buscar a Guillermo para decirle cuanto lo ama. Guillermo le dice a Pedro que no cree que sea Ana la que le contesto el mensaje de texto, ya que ella es muy comprensiva y está enamorada de él. Marilda quiere tratar de convencer a sus hijos para que no vayan a la boda y así ella no se queda sola en la casa. Pedro es el complica de Cristóbal para separar a Ana de Guillermo y evitar que se junten y se den cuenta que se aman y que Guillermo dejo a Yenny. Carlos Enrique quiere reconquistar a su mujer pero lo que siente por Lazara es más fuerte y no lo puede controlar.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la cancha de basquet Yubiri se reúne con Wilker para fijarle a este su posición al sentirse desplazada en su vida por sus admiradoras y su carrera - Yubiri siguiendo el consejo de Briggite y Bienvenida que la obligan a buscar su felicidad le plantea a Wilker el termino de su noviazgo a pesar de amarlo - Wilker sintiéndose temeroso de llegar a perder el amor de Yubiri le hace a esta la promesa de cambiar muy a pesar de su fama para continuar teniéndola como novia.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie no le cree a su marido que tenga un hijo con Brenda. Magdalena se asegura que Sofía le salga de testigo en su juicio de divorcio pero lo que no sabe es que ella está en la cama junto a Agustín, planeando perjudicarla. Efraín llega a su casa después de tener sexo a Valentina y encuentra a su esposa trabajando, la saluda y le miente acerca de dónde viene. Gabriel le cuenta a Angie que dono semen para parejas que no pueden tener bebes, a cambio de dinero. Angie se fue de la casa a pasar la noche fuera para pensar acerca de lo que hizo su marido.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela deja la mansión Tariffi pero apoya a Ricardo ante la enfermedad de Elizabeth. Cecilia llega a Caracas por el secuestro de Ricardito y reclama la custodia de sus sobrinos, enfrentándose a Ricardo. Candelaria es detenida y Elizabeth hospitalizada tras un desmayo. En el ámbito amoroso, Margot rompe con Alejandro tras descubrir su infidelidad, mientras Katiuska conspira para casarse con Ricardo y Marcelo impone los términos de su boda a María del Pilar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo decide romper sociedad con Rosalía tras el atentado. Alejandro le pide a José Luis vigilar a Rosa. Carlos enfrenta a Rosalía haciéndole ver el daño que hace. Vilma se ala con Erasto contra Adolfo. Rosa va camino a la tienda de Consuelo pensando cómo enfrentarla, pero Eustoquio la engaña con falsos documentos y la lleva al monte para matarla. Junior empieza a perder la memoria preocupando a Marisela. Alejandro investiga en la Guajira cuando otro auto lo embiste sacando su carro de la carretera. Humberto chantajea a Erasto con copias de los documentos del Bramón.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Busqueda De La Piedra Magica
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar cuando Gargamel consigue que su libro de hechizos conjure un nuevo lugar más hermoso para que los Pitufos vivan en él: ¡un lugar perfecto para que pueda tenderles una trampa!

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: El Primer Telepitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo vierte una poción mágica sobre el nuevo sembrado de melones, que crecen instantáneamente e inundan la aldea y el bosque. Los Pitufos usan las flores a modo de teléfono; sin embargo, antes de que Gargamel pueda rastrear sus voces, las flores se convierten en melones y eso significa el fin del telepitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su búsqueda de algo novedoso, Pitufo Vanidoso se pone un sombrero mágico creado por Gargamel que le deja la cara hecha un adefesio. Mediante una argucia, Papá Pitufo consigue robarle el antídoto al malvado mago, logrando así que Pitufo Vanidoso recupere su belleza.

programme.title: Poema Al Tiempo
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo, Pitufo Torpe y Pitufina descubren el reloj de arena del tiempo en una cueva y empiezan a trastear con él, lo que provoca que el tiempo se descontrole para todos los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Mejor Memoria De La Aldea
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. Gargamel lo captura e intenta que le revele la fórmula de invisibilidad de Papá Pitufo, pero, en el último segundo, Pitufo Torpe le engaña diciéndole unos ingredientes erróneos.

programme.title: El Buen Vecino De Pitufo
programme.desc: Cuando la casa de Pitufo Filósofo se quema, se muda con sus compañeros Pitufos; y, uno detrás de otro, le echan debido a sus intromisiones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. programme.desc: Eduardo rechaza a toda su familia, haciendo alianzas políticas para quitarle las minas a su papá y hermanos, Esmeralda se encuentra con Ricardo, a pesar de que él no la ha olvidado, ella lo rechaza pues no pretende volver al estar apurada intentando sacar a su hijo de la Victoria. Más adelante, Eduardo se encuentra con Esmeralda cuando a él le hacen un atentado.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Lo que parece ser un trabajo rutinario de control de plagas se convierte en una pesadilla al estilo de los 'Gremlins' mientras Astro y el equipo intentan derrotar a un ejército creciente de ratas fuera de control que ha descendido sobre un centro comercial. Lo que empeora las cosas es que la clave de por qué las ratas se han vuelto tan locas no se puede ver ni tocar, ¡solo se puede oler!

programme.title: Una Navidad Casi Perfecta
programme.desc: Después de perder su trabajo y a su novio, una aspirante a novelista romántica se muda de su apartamento en Londres a una casa en la playa en Sunshine Coast, donde descubre que el amor puede ser a la vez perfecto y complicado.

programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengance - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: For Mike Pentecost and his son Jacob, Illinois deer camp has become a tradition they look forward to every single year. It’s a place filled with memories, time spent together, and a shared love for chasing whitetails.But this trip carries a little more meaning. At 17 years old, Jacob is heading into his final year of being eligible for Illinois’ special youth season and he and Mike are hoping to make one last trip to deer camp count.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.
These hunters know the key to taking giant whitetails consistently is all about being in the right place at the right time. Brady Snyder hunts down a giant 200″ buck in Iowa from 2023.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: For decades, Paul Butski has set the standard in turkey calling. His name is etched into the NWTF Grand National Calling Championships Hall of Fame, and his influence stretches far beyond the stage. He didn’t just win competitions, he shaped the way we talk to turkeys – and more importantly, the way we hunt them.
If you hunt big whitetails this is a must see! Follow Adam Hays and Lee Lakosky as they hunt for multiple giants and learn some tactics for harvesting monster whitetails!

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: After starting turkey season off on the road, it's time for us to come back home to Pennsylvania and hunt some turkeys on our home turf! Also joining us this week are our good friends from The Grind Outdoors who come in to hunt some long beards with us.

programme.desc: Cam começa a se questionar quanto ao seu relacionamento com a Kayla na casa. O jeito sempre brincalhão de Daniel acaba afastando a Samantha. Agora a casa precisa enfrentar a Cabine da Verdade mais importante até este momento do jogo.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A chapa esquenta entre o Cam e o Kwasi quando o Kwasi resolve entrar em ação e dar em cima da Kayla. Asia fica irritada quando começa a acreditar que certas pessoas na casa não estão sendo verdadeiras com ela. Zak tem que fazer uma escolha.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.sub-title: Eu quero que você me queira
programme.desc: Nutsa fica cada vez mais apaixonada por Brett, enquanto a incapacidade de Brett de superar o fim da relação com Cali traz consequências para a casa inteira. Moe é forçado a começar a jogar o jogo. Lewis revela o que realmente sente à Asia.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A obsessão extrema de Bria por Zak e os antigos hábitos de pegador dele colocam em risco a habilidade da casa de jogar o jogo do amor. Cali resolve elaborar uma estratégia para descobrir quais casais fortes são Pares Ideais e quais não são.
